title: 前缀缓存
note_on_kind: 标准代码章（非 primer）：走 implementer 精简版 + lint_fidelity 全链。Part IV 第三章——ch13 已立池/块表/引用计数/逆序 free 的骨架（前缀缓存只作为 allocate_slots 两个黑盒参数出现）、ch14 已立账本/门/混合组化（hash_block_size 的选择已定：GCD 或 prefix_match_unit）。本章打开黑盒：链式哈希怎么算、命中怎么查、LRU 两个不变量怎么保命中率、抢占恢复为什么撞上哈希表反而变便宜（F2 收口）、半截共享块怎么 CoW、混合模型的 junction 怎么钉住。L0 缩放 = KV 账本列缓存区（kv_column）。
hook_suggestion: 「同一个 system prompt 一天被 prefill 一万遍，凭什么第二遍开始能整段跳过？vLLM 里没有 radix 树、也没有专门的 LRU cache 对象——靠的是每满 hash_block_size（默认 16）个 token 拌上前缀哈希、塞进一个平面 dict：命中凭什么『断一处即停、无需回溯』？驱逐顺序凭什么保住最长的可复用前缀（两个藏在注释里的不变量）？ch11 被抢占打回原形的请求，撞上这张哈希表怎么就『重算变重载』了？两个人共享半截没写满的块，谁接着写、凭什么写不坏对方？混合模型一层稠密一层稀疏，共享前缀的 junction 怎么才不被稀疏驻留裁掉？」（从 Part IV hook『显存就那么多，KV cache 必须活到最后』+ 本章主题『前缀缓存』+ deepread/memory-kv.json why_chains[2]（链式哈希非 radix）、why_chains[3]（LRU 双不变量）、why_chains[4]（抢占重算被缓存变便宜=F2）、why_chains[7]（块内 CoW）、why_chains[8]（Marconi 钉住）提炼）
scope_note: 主线 = 前缀的『算→查→挂→写→留→逐』一生 + 三个 v0.27.1 新面：(A) 链式哈希与平面哈希表——请求侧增量算哈希（request_block_hasher 只算新满块、parent 链式、extra_keys 防跨语义）、NONE_HASH 随机种子、BlockHashToBlockMap 平面 dict（故意不去重保块表 append-only、union 省 GC）、radix 迷思澄清（v0=hash+Evictor、SGLang=radix 树、v1 从 day one 就是链式哈希——全仓 v1 core grep radix 零命中）；(B) 命中与复用——get_computed_blocks（max_cache_hit_length=num_tokens−1 全命中退一 token）、FullAttentionManager.find_longest_cache_hit phase 1 沿链 miss 即停 + phase 2 块内细粒度探测、touch 救回（ref_cnt+1 出队）、cache_full_blocks 满块注册（block_mask 控入表）；(C) LRU 双不变量——逆序 free（尾块=更长前缀更难复用先驱逐，类文档明言次序规则在类外）+ free_blocks 劈分（无哈希块 prepend 队头先驱逐，#42656；缓存关闭跳过劈分保 GPU 局部性）+ 惰性驱逐（get_new_blocks 复用时才 _maybe_evict_cached_block 摘哈希、反向索引清别名、move_block_hashes 重指 CoW 拷贝）；(D) F2 收口——抢占 free 不清哈希 → 被抢占请求重排回 waiting 重走准入查询 → get_computed_blocks 重命中自己的前缀 → touch 救回：『重算』变『重载元数据+补算』，最坏（块被挤出哈希表）退化为全量重 prefill；(E) 块内 CoW 部分命中（v0.27.1 新）——hash_block_size<block_size 时 cache_partial_block 在块内边界注册细粒度条目（不分配新块）、find phase 2 探测、命中后共享尾块换私有 cow 块（_apply_cow 登记拷贝对）→ 跨进程拷贝管线（take_kv_cache_block_copies → SchedulerOutput.kv_cache_block_copies → worker copy_kv_cache_blocks_inplace，两端引用步序栅栏）；(F) 混合不动点与 Marconi 钉住——HybridKVCacheCoordinator.find_longest_cache_hit 不动点（每类型接受或缩短、full 排首向下封闭只查一次、simple hybrid 一轮）、num_uncached_common_prefix_tokens=longest−reconciled 是 junction 原料 → shared_prefix_boundary 写回 Request → cache_blocks reachable_boundaries 特赦 + _mamba_block_aligned_split 把 chunk 停在 junction；稀疏驻留 retention_interval 三态（VLLM_PREFIX_CACHE_RETENTION_INTERVAL：None 稠密/0 只留 replay 边界/正数每段一条）。边界与邻章分工：池的构造/块表/槽位恒等式/引用计数骨架归 ch13；账本/准入门/水位/混合组化与 hash_block_size 的选择归 ch14（本章消费 hash_block_size）；KVConnector 双面契约/外部命中/WAITING_FOR_REMOTE_KVS/partial-tail offload 归 ch16（本章只在 delay_cache_blocks/外部命中处一句带过）；SWA 窗外回收与 null 换位归 ch14（本章只消费 [NULL,...] 形态与 block_mask）；eagle/投机解码的丢尾块分支、DCP/PCP 乘子为可省略分支。

stations.what: 请求侧增量哈希：构造尾与每次 append token 后 update_block_hashes → request_block_hasher（kv_cache_utils.py:L705-L748）对每个新满 hash_block_size 块算 hash_block_tokens（parent 链式 + extra_keys）追加 block_hashes——哈希归 Request 持有，账本只读不写

装配开关：enable_prefix_caching（默认 True，config/cache.py:L93）或装了 connector 才建 request_block_hasher 并 init_none_hash 播种（随机 32 字节或 PYTHONHASHSEED 派生，kv_cache_utils.py:L99-L114）；关缓存则 _block_hasher=None、请求侧从不算哈希

准入查询：waiting 循环里 num_computed_tokens==0 的请求查本地命中 get_computed_blocks（kv_cache_manager.py:L229-L295）——skip 谓词挡掉关缓存/prompt logprobs/pooling；max_cache_hit_length=num_tokens−1（全命中也须重算最后一个 token 拿 logits，注释原话；块对齐还可能回退整块）
链上找最长命中：phase 1 沿满块哈希链逐块 get_cached_block 查平面 dict，第一个 miss 即断——链式哈希保证 miss 之后必 miss、无需回溯；phase 2（fine_grained：hash_block_size<block_size）在第一个不满块内自高向低探块内哈希边界，探到即命中到细粒度边界

混合不动点（多组才走）：每注意力类型对候选命中长度『接受或缩短』、任一缩短重启全类型校验、长度单调递减有下界必收敛；full 组排最前且向下封闭（查一次后只 min 裁剪）；simple hybrid（1 full+1 other）一轮即停；num_uncached_common_prefix_tokens = longest − reconciled = 各组都认但稀疏组还没缓的共享前缀（Marconi junction 原料）

挂命中块：add_local_computed_blocks 调 block_pool.touch（L702-L717：ref_cnt+1；ref_cnt==0 时 O(1) remove 出 free queue——把驱逐候选救回）→ null 填 skipped 段 → 命中块 extend 进 req_to_blocks；部分命中记 _partial_hit_reqs 并把 num_cached_block 压回整块数
部分命中 CoW 换尾：allocate_new_blocks 发现 _partial_hit_reqs 有账 → 取 1 块私有 cow 块（预算里 get_num_blocks_to_allocate 多记的那块，L226-L230）→ _apply_cow（L405-L425）把请求块表里的共享尾块原地换成 cow 块、登记 (source, cow) 拷贝对、cow 额外 +1 引用

写回：cache_blocks 收 reachable_boundaries=[replay 边界(num_prompt−1), junction(shared_prefix_boundary)] → reachable_block_mask → cache_full_blocks（block_pool.py:L225-L342）给新满块 set_block_hash+insert 进 BlockHashToBlockMap（partial→full 晋升先摘旧条目）；block_size>hash_block_size 时 _cache_partial_tail_block（L791-L819）把 prompt 尾注册成部分条目；调度侧配合 _mamba_block_aligned_split（scheduler.py:L424-L437）把 chunk 停在 junction 让边界状态真被算出来

CoW 拷贝过线：take_kv_cache_block_copies（kv_cache_manager.py:L831-L846）drain (source,cow) 对 → SchedulerOutput.kv_cache_block_copies → worker copy_kv_cache_blocks_inplace（gpu_model_runner.py:L1223-L1228）在 GPU 上真拷；两端块引用保留到拷贝跑完（_free_cow_retained_blocks 步序栅栏 scheduler.py:L2356-L2365）

抢占打回（F2 起点，抢占机制本体归 ch11）：_preempt_request → _free_request_blocks → kv_cache_manager.free（L567-L578）——free 全部块但【不清哈希】：free_blocks 只动 ref_cnt 和队列位置，block_hash 原样留在 map 里；num_computed_tokens=0、回 waiting 队头

逆序 free 与 LRU 劈分（双不变量）：manager.free 逆序传入（single_type:L519-L527——尾块先挂回、排更靠驱逐端，FreeKVCacheBlockQueue 类文档 L193-L200 明言此规则在类外维持）；free_blocks 把归零块劈两半——无哈希块 prepend_n 到队头先驱逐（#42656『never match APC』）、有哈希块 append_n 到 LRU 尾——被抢占请求的前缀块带哈希排在最可复用端

惰性驱逐：池紧时 get_new_blocks 从队头批量取块、逐块 _maybe_evict_cached_block → _remove_cached_block_hashes（L571-L590：主哈希+反向索引别名一次摘干净）——驱逐不发生在 free 时、发生在复用时；move_block_hashes（L629-L645）在 CoW 后把哈希条目重指到私有拷贝。被抢占请求若在重排回来前块被取走复用 → 前缀失效 → 第 3 站退化为全量重 prefill（F2 最坏分支）；没被取走则重走第 3-6 站命中自己的前缀、touch 救回——『重算』变『重载元数据+补算』

stations_note: 站号 = 一个前缀的『算→查→挂→写→留→逐』一生：第 1-2 站请求侧把哈希备好（开关决定算不算）；第 3-5 站查命中（主路径链上走 → 混合不动点调和多组）；第 6-8 站挂块复用与写回（touch 救回 / CoW 换尾 / 满块+部分条目入表）；第 9 站 CoW 拷贝跨进程落地；第 10-12 站是『留与逐』——抢占打回不清哈希（F2 起点）→ 逆序+劈分挂回自由队列 → 池紧时才惰性摘哈希。F2 回收在第 12 站注释收口：被抢占者重排回来重走 3-6 站。正文按讲解需要编排——建议先立『哈希怎么算/为什么链式』（m1-m2），再『查与挂』（m5-m6），再『LRU 双不变量』（m8-m9），然后 F2 收口（m11），最后细粒度 CoW（m13-m14）与混合不动点/Marconi（m15-m17）作进阶幕。radix 迷思在开篇即澄清（deepread first_read_suggestion 点名必做）。

key_classes.name: hash_block_tokens / request_block_hasher
key_classes.responsibility: 链式哈希的算与攒：单块哈希=H(parent_hash, 本块 tokens, extra_keys)（L596-L623，首块 parent=NONE_HASH）；请求侧闭包只算新满 hash_block_size 的块、逐块链式追加（L691-L748）。块哈希即整条前缀的指纹（Merkle 链）。

key_classes.name: BlockHashToBlockMap
key_classes.responsibility: 前缀缓存查找表：{BlockHashWithGroupId(哈希+group_id 打包 bytes, kv_cache_utils.py:L57-L66) → KVCacheBlock | dict[block_id, KVCacheBlock]}。故意不去重（NOTE #1：保 block_id 不变、块表 append-only）；union 类型省 GC（NOTE #2）。get_one_block/insert/pop 三原语。

key_classes.name: BlockPool（前缀面）
key_classes.responsibility: 缓存登记与驱逐的管家：cache_full_blocks（满块+block_mask 入表、partial→full 晋升）、cache_partial_block（块内细粒度条目）、_insert_block_hash/_remove_cached_block_hashes（主哈希+反向索引双向维护）、touch（救回）、free_blocks（劈分）、get_new_blocks+_maybe_evict_cached_block（惰性驱逐）、move_block_hashes（CoW 重指）。cached_block_hashes_by_block（L185）是部分条目时代的反向索引。

key_classes.name: FullAttentionManager
key_classes.responsibility: 全注意力组的前缀面：find_longest_cache_hit（phase 1 链上走 + phase 2 块内细粒度探测，L682-L777）、cache_blocks 重载 + _cache_partial_tail_block（prompt 尾部分条目，L779-L819）、add_local_computed_blocks（touch+挂块+部分命中记账）、allocate_new_blocks（CoW 换尾）、_apply_cow。supports_fine_grained_hash_lookup=True。

key_classes.name: SingleTypeKVCacheManager (ABC)
key_classes.responsibility: 各注意力类型块管理器的基类：定义 reachable_block_mask（默认 None=稠密全缓存；SWA/Mamba 重写为稀疏+边界特赦）、free（逆序）、cache_blocks（reachable_boundaries 面向全部子类）、_partial_hit_reqs/_pending_cow_copies 部分命中簿记。

key_classes.name: HybridKVCacheCoordinator / UnitaryKVCacheCoordinator / KVCacheCoordinatorNoPrefixCache
key_classes.responsibility: 命中查找的协调层三态：单组直接委托唯一 manager（Unitary，L486-L503）；混合走不动点（L685-L817，full 排首向下封闭、收敛后产出 num_uncached_common_prefix_tokens）；关缓存返回恒空命中（L424-L432）。retention_interval 在基类构造校验（L30-L57 + L112-L116）。

key_classes.name: KVCacheManager（前缀面）
key_classes.responsibility: 对调度器的门面：get_computed_blocks（L229-L295，含 skip 谓词/junction 写回）、free（L567-L578 先放 pins 再逆序）、take_kv_cache_block_copies（L831-L846 CoW 拷贝对+retained）、record_prefix_cache_stats/make_prefix_cache_stats（L202-L227 观测）。

key_classes.name: Request（哈希面）
key_classes.responsibility: block_hashes 的唯一持有者：构造时与每次 append token 后增量补算（L249-L265）；shared_prefix_boundary 字段（L190-L193，调度器写、缓存读的跨模块协议）；skip_reading_prefix_cache（L211 + L291-L302，prompt logprobs/pooling 跳读）。

key_classes.name: Scheduler（前缀面）
key_classes.responsibility: 准入查询与配合面：waiting 循环查命中（L744-L766）、_mamba_block_aligned_split 强制停点（L424-L437，junction/partial-tail 边界对齐）、CoW 拷贝打包与步序栅栏（L1181-L1190 + L2356-L2365）、_preempt_request（L1274-L1315，free 不清哈希——F2 起点）。

data_flow: 总述：本章数据流 = deepread/memory-kv.json data_flow 的 [入场]（Request 构造时增量算 block_hashes）+ [调度]（waiting 循环 get_computed_blocks → find_longest_cache_hit）+ [分配] 的命中/CoW/写回段（allocate_new_computed_blocks 两阶段 touch → allocate_new_blocks 部分命中 CoW → cache_blocks 满/部分条目入表）+ [终局]（逆序 free + 劈分挂回——前缀留在哈希表里等下一个请求命中）四段，引用不重挖。

why_chains.decision: 前缀缓存 = 链式块哈希 + 平面哈希表（重要澄清：vLLM v0/v1 主线从来不是 radix 树）
why_chains.old_design: 两条旧路线：v0 自己的 APC = hash + Evictor（2024-03-02 commit ce4f5a29f "Add Automatic Prefix Caching (#2762)"）；SGLang RadixAttention = radix 树（arXiv:2312.07104）。很多读者带着「vLLM=论文+SGLang radix」的混合印象来。V1 alpha（2024-10-22 commit 6c5af09b3）落地时 get_computed_blocks 是存根，注释「# TODO(woosuk): Implement hash-based caching.」——TODO 里写的就是 hash-based。2024-11-07 commit 201fc0773 "[V1] Prefix caching (take 2) (#9972)" 落地。
why_chains.pain: 共享前缀（system prompt/few-shot/多轮历史）重复 prefill 烧算力。radix 树在 Python 侧指针密集：节点对象分配给 GC 压力大、match/insert/evict 不变量复杂、与 chunked prefill/SWA 的块对齐语义难严丝合缝——这些正是 v1 高并发调度循环最付不起的 CPU 成本。
why_chains.solution: Merkle 式链式哈希：hash_i = H(parent_hash_{i-1}, tokens_i, extra_keys)（vllm/v1/core/kv_cache_utils.py:L596-L623 hash_block_tokens）；请求侧随 token 到达增量计算（request.py:L249-L265）；查找沿哈希链顺序走到第一个 miss 即停（single_type_kv_cache_manager.py:L682-L777，phase 1 L731-L739）；存储=平面 dict（block_pool.py:L33-L140 BlockHashToBlockMap）。满块才缓存 cache_full_blocks（L225-L342）。extra_keys 把 LoRA 名/MM 哈希/cache_salt 织进哈希防跨请求污染（kv_cache_utils.py:L430-L593）。
why_chains.cost: ① 满块粒度之外的命中要靠 v0.27.1 的部分块条目（WC5）；全命中时必须重算最后一个 token 才有 logits（kv_cache_manager.py:L253-L258 注释原话）；② 故意不去重——同哈希允许多块并存，为块表 append-only（NOTE #1，block_pool.py:L47-L53），代价是相同前缀的显存冗余；③ 链式意味着前缀任何一处改动后面全部失效；④ 驱逐惰性隐式：块被重新分配时才摘哈希（get_new_blocks→_maybe_evict_cached_block，block_pool.py:L647-L700）。

why_chains.decision: LRU 驱逐顺序的两个隐藏不变量：free 必须逆序 + 无哈希块先于缓存块驱逐
why_chains.old_design: 朴素做法双坑：其一，free 按分配顺序挂回空闲表——LRU 头部会是一条缓存链的前几个块，驱逐从「前缀的头」开始把最长可复用前缀拦腰斩断；其二（v0.21 之前），所有释放块一律当 LRU 缓存条目——从未进过哈希表的块（不可能是命中）排在缓存块后面驱逐，白占显存。
why_chains.pain: 被卡的指标是前缀命中率（尤其共享 system prompt 场景）：驱逐顺序错 = 命中率静默劣化，不炸不错只是慢。无哈希块滞留 = 可用容量被「永不命中」的块挤占。
why_chains.solution: 不变量一（逆序 free）：docstring 原话「We free the blocks in reverse order so that the tail blocks are evicted first when caching is enabled」（kv_cache_manager.py:L567-L574；实现 single_type_kv_cache_manager.py:L519-L527 free_blocks(reversed(...))）。次序规则写在 FreeKVCacheBlockQueue 类文档（kv_cache_utils.py:L184-L204）：「The least recent used block is at the front (LRU)」「the one with more hash tokens (the tail of a block chain) is at the front」。不变量二（2026-06-16 commit 520828789 "Apply LRU policy only to proper cache entries (#42656)"）：free_blocks 把释放块劈两半——无哈希块 prepend_n 到队头（先驱逐）、有哈希块 append_n 到 LRU 尾（block_pool.py:L719-L742，注释「Blocks without hash get evicted first」）；缓存关闭时跳过劈分保持 append 以获得 GPU 局部性（2026-07-25 commit a82f1b388 #48017）。侵入式双向链表零对象分配（L188-L191 类文档原话「does not allocate any Python objects」）。
why_chains.cost: 两个不变量都靠约定维持、无断言保护——任何新的 free 路径不遵守就静默劣化命中率（「顺序即策略」的教学样本）；劈分路径让 free_blocks 多一次遍历（缓存关闭时已优化掉）。

def hash_block_tokens(
    hash_function: Callable[[Any], bytes],
    parent_block_hash: BlockHash | None,
    curr_block_token_ids: Sequence[int],
    extra_keys: tuple[Any, ...] | None = None,
) -> BlockHash:
    """Computes a hash value corresponding to the contents of a block and
    the contents of the preceding block(s). The hash value is used for
    prefix caching. We use LRU cache for this function to avoid recomputing
    hash values for the same block contents.
    Args:
        hash_function: The hash function used to compute block hash.
        parent_block_hash: The hash of the parent block. None
            if this is the first block.
        curr_block_token_ids: A list of token ids in the current
            block. The current block is assumed to be full.
        extra_keys: Extra keys for the block.
    Returns:
        The hash value of the block and the token ids in the block.
        The entire tuple is used as the hash key of the block.
    """
    if not parent_block_hash:
        parent_block_hash = NONE_HASH

    curr_block_token_ids_tuple = tuple(curr_block_token_ids)
    return BlockHash(
        hash_function((parent_block_hash, curr_block_token_ids_tuple, extra_keys))
    )

def request_block_hasher(request: Request) -> list[BlockHash]:
        start_token_idx = len(request.block_hashes) * hash_block_size
        num_tokens = request.num_tokens

        if start_token_idx + hash_block_size > num_tokens:
            # Early stop when there no new full blocks created.
            return []

        curr_mm_idx = 0
        if start_token_idx > 0:
            # Set curr_mm_idx = -1 to indicate the last mm input.
            # Note that since we reach to this branch only when the block is
            # completed with generated tokens, we only need to consider the
            # last mm input.
            curr_mm_idx = -1

        prev_block_hash_value = (
            request.block_hashes[-1] if request.block_hashes else None
        )
        new_block_hashes: list[BlockHash] = []
        while True:
            end_token_idx = start_token_idx + hash_block_size
            if end_token_idx > num_tokens:
                # We only hash full blocks
                break

            # MM and LoRA requests need extra keys for block-hash computation.
            extra_keys, curr_mm_idx = generate_block_hash_extra_keys(
                request, start_token_idx, end_token_idx, curr_mm_idx
            )

            # Compute the hash of the current block
            block_tokens = request.all_token_ids[start_token_idx:end_token_idx]
            block_hash = hash_block_tokens(
                caching_hash_fn, prev_block_hash_value, block_tokens, extra_keys
            )

            new_block_hashes.append(block_hash)
            start_token_idx += hash_block_size
            prev_block_hash_value = block_hash

        return new_block_hashes

    return request_block_hasher

class FreeKVCacheBlockQueue:
    """This class organizes a list of KVCacheBlock objects to a doubly linked
    list of free blocks. We implement this class instead of using Python
    builtin deque to support removing a block in the middle of the queue
    in O(1) time. To close the performance gap to the builtin deque which is
    implemented in C++, this class does not allocate any Python objects when
    manipulating the linked list. Instead, this class manipulates the
    prev_free_block and next_free_block attributes of the given blocks.

    The queue is ordered by block ID in the beginning. When a block is allocated
    and then freed, it will be appended back with the eviction order:
    1. The least recent used block is at the front (LRU).
    2. If two blocks have the same last accessed time (allocated by the
       same sequence), the one with more hash tokens (the tail of a block
       chain) is at the front.
    Note that we maintain this order by reversing the block order when free
    blocks of a request. This operation is outside of this class.

    Args:
        blocks: A list of KVCacheBlock objects.
    """

def prepend_n(self, blocks: list[KVCacheBlock]) -> None:
        """Put a list of blocks at the front of the free list."""
        if len(blocks) == 0:
            return

        first_block = self.fake_free_list_head.next_free_block
        assert first_block is not None, (
            "next_free_block of fake_free_list_head should always exist"
        )

        prev_block = self.fake_free_list_head

        first_block.prev_free_block = prev_block

        self.num_free_blocks += len(blocks)

class BlockHashListWithBlockSize:
    """
    Convert block-hash granularity from `hash_block_size` to `target_block_size`.
    Used when KV cache groups have different block sizes: `hash_block_size`
    is the size used to compute the original `block_hashes`; `target_block_size`
    is the group's actual block size.

    Currently, only scaling up by an integer factor is supported (i.e.,
    `target_block_size` is a multiple of `hash_block_size`). Conversion is
    performed lazily on access for efficiency. Each `hash_block_size` hash is
    already chained over its entire prefix, so the hash at the last
    `hash_block_size` boundary of a `target_block_size` block uniquely
    fingerprints that block's prefix; we use it directly.

    Example (`hash_block_size` = 16, `target_block_size` = 32):
    the second 16-size hash already covers tokens 0-31, so it is the 32-size
    hash:

    Block hashes with block_size 16:
    | Token Range | 0-15 | 16-31 | 32-47 | 48-63 |
    |-------------|------|-------|-------|-------|
    | Hash        | A    | B     | C     | D     |

    Block hashes with block_size 32:
    | Token Range | 0-31 | 32-63 |
    |-------------|------|-------|
    | Hash        | B    | D     |

    Args:
        block_hashes: Block hashes to convert, computed at `hash_block_size`.
        hash_block_size: Block size at which `block_hashes` were computed.
        target_block_size: Desired block size; must be a multiple of `hash_block_size`.
    """

def resolve_block_hashes(
    block_hashes: BlockHashList,
    hash_block_size: int,
    block_size: int,
    *,
    supports_fine_grained_hash_lookup: bool = False,
    alignment_tokens: int | None = None,
) -> BlockHashList:
    """Resolve the block-hash view at ``block_size``.

    When ``block_size`` equals ``hash_block_size``, reuse the precomputed block
    hashes directly; otherwise view them at ``block_size`` granularity.
    Fine-grained lookup keeps the original hashes for partial cache hits.
    """
    if block_size == hash_block_size:
        return block_hashes
    if isinstance(block_hashes, BlockHashListWithBlockSize):
        # Already a block-size view
        assert block_hashes.scale_factor == block_size // hash_block_size
        return block_hashes
    # Fine-grained partial hits keep the raw hashes. The caller passes
    # alignment_tokens = hash_block_size to enable them, else >= block_size.
    if (
        supports_fine_grained_hash_lookup
        and alignment_tokens is not None
        and alignment_tokens < block_size
        and block_size % alignment_tokens == 0
    ):
        return block_hashes
    assert block_size % hash_block_size == 0
    return BlockHashListWithBlockSize(block_hashes, hash_block_size, block_size)

def touch(self, blocks: Sequence[KVCacheBlock]) -> None:
        """Touch a block increases its reference count by 1, and may remove
        the block from the free queue. This is used when a block is hit by
        another request with the same prefix.

        Args:
            blocks: A list of blocks to touch.
        """
        for block in blocks:
            # ref_cnt=0 means this block is in the free list (i.e. eviction
            # candidate), so remove it.
            if block.ref_cnt == 0 and not block.is_null:
                self.free_block_queue.remove(block)

                self.metrics_collector.on_block_accessed(block)

def free_blocks(self, ordered_blocks: Iterable[KVCacheBlock]) -> None:
        """Free a list of blocks. The blocks should be ordered by their
        eviction priority, where the first block will be evicted first.

        Args:
            ordered_blocks: A list of blocks to free ordered by their eviction
                priority.
        """
        # Identify blocks with hash (LRU cache) and without it (never match APC)
        blocks_with_hash = []
        blocks_without_hash = []
        for block in ordered_blocks:
            block.ref_cnt -= 1
            if block.ref_cnt == 0 and not block.is_null:
                # When caching is disabled we always append for better
                # GPU cache locality from reusing recently used blocks
                if block.block_hash is None and self.enable_caching:
                    blocks_without_hash.append(block)
                else:
                    blocks_with_hash.append(block)

        # Blocks without hash get evicted first - prepend them last to the tail
        self.free_block_queue.prepend_n(blocks_without_hash)
        self.free_block_queue.append_n(blocks_with_hash)

def add_local_computed_blocks(
        self,
        request_id: str,
        new_computed_blocks: Sequence[KVCacheBlock],
        num_local_computed_tokens: int,
        num_external_computed_tokens: int,
    ) -> None:
        """
        Add the locally cached (prefix-hit) blocks to the request:
        1. Touch the computed blocks (paired with adding them to `req_blocks`)
           so their ref_cnt exactly tracks the referencing requests.
        1.5. (Optional) For sliding window, skipped blocks are padded with nulls.
        2. Add the remaining computed blocks.

        Args:
            request_id: The request ID.
            new_computed_blocks: The new computed blocks just hitting the
                prefix cache.
            num_local_computed_tokens: The number of local computed tokens.
            num_external_computed_tokens: The number of external computed tokens.
        """
        # The coordinator only calls this for first-time allocations (running
        # requests are short-circuited there), so the request has no blocks yet.
        req_blocks = self.req_to_blocks[request_id]
        assert len(req_blocks) == 0
        num_total_computed_tokens = (
            num_local_computed_tokens + num_external_computed_tokens
        )
        num_skipped_tokens = self.get_num_skipped_tokens(num_total_computed_tokens)
        num_skipped_blocks = num_skipped_tokens // self.block_size
        if num_skipped_blocks > 0:
            # It is possible that all new computed blocks are skipped when
            # num_skipped_blocks > len(new_computed_blocks).
            new_computed_blocks = new_computed_blocks[num_skipped_blocks:]

        # Touch the computed blocks to make sure they won't be evicted.
        if self.enable_caching:
            self.block_pool.touch(new_computed_blocks)
        else:
            assert not any(new_computed_blocks), (
                "Computed blocks should be empty when prefix caching is disabled"
            )

        # Skip blocks are padded with null blocks.
        req_blocks.extend([self._null_block] * num_skipped_blocks)
        # Add the remaining computed blocks.
        req_blocks.extend(new_computed_blocks)
        # All cached hits (including skipped nulls) are already cached; mark
        # them so cache_blocks() will not try to re-cache blocks that already
        # have a block_hash set.
        self.num_cached_block[request_id] = len(req_blocks)
        if self._has_partial_local_hit(new_computed_blocks, num_local_computed_tokens):
            # Record the partial tail for the CoW redirect in
            # allocate_new_blocks; cap the cached count at the full blocks so
            # cache_blocks() re-caches the private copy once full.
            block_idx = num_local_computed_tokens // self.block_size
            self._partial_hit_reqs[request_id] = (block_idx, new_computed_blocks[-1])
            self.num_cached_block[request_id] = block_idx

def _apply_cow(
        self,
        request_id: str,
        block_idx: int,
        source_block: KVCacheBlock,
        cow_block: KVCacheBlock,
    ) -> None:
        """Redirect a partial prefix-cache hit to a private CoW block.

        Both copy endpoints stay retained until the copy has run on the worker,
        so a same-step free cannot recycle them: ``source_block`` keeps its
        hit-ref, ``cow_block`` takes an extra ref beyond the one handed to the
        request.
        """
        req_blocks = self.req_to_blocks[request_id]
        assert block_idx < len(req_blocks)
        assert req_blocks[block_idx] is source_block
        assert not source_block.is_null and source_block.ref_cnt > 0
        req_blocks[block_idx] = cow_block
        self._pending_cow_copies.append((source_block, cow_block))
        cow_block.ref_cnt += 1

        num_full_blocks = num_tokens // self.block_size

        if num_cached_blocks >= num_full_blocks:
            return

        # Token boundaries whose reachable tail must be retained under sparse
        # retention: the replay boundary (``num_prompt - 1``, capped by
        # ``get_computed_blocks``) and any detected shared-prefix junction.
        reachable_boundaries = [request.num_prompt_tokens - 1]
        if request.shared_prefix_boundary:
            reachable_boundaries.append(request.shared_prefix_boundary)

        block_mask = self.reachable_block_mask(
            start_block=num_cached_blocks,
            end_block=num_full_blocks,
            alignment_tokens=self.scheduler_block_size,
            kv_cache_spec=self.kv_cache_spec,
            use_eagle=self.use_eagle,
            retention_interval=retention_interval,
            reachable_boundaries=reachable_boundaries,
        )
        self.block_pool.cache_full_blocks(
            request=request,
            blocks=self.req_to_blocks[request.request_id],
            num_cached_blocks=num_cached_blocks,
            num_full_blocks=num_full_blocks,
            block_size=self.block_size,
            kv_cache_group_id=self.kv_cache_group_id,
            block_mask=block_mask,
        )

        self.num_cached_block[request.request_id] = num_full_blocks

def find_longest_cache_hit(
        cls,
        block_hashes: BlockHashList,
        max_length: int,
        kv_cache_group_ids: list[int],
        block_pool: BlockPool,
        kv_cache_spec: KVCacheSpec,
        drop_eagle_block: bool,
        alignment_tokens: int,
        dcp_world_size: int = 1,
        pcp_world_size: int = 1,
    ) -> tuple[tuple[list[KVCacheBlock], ...], int]:
        assert isinstance(
            kv_cache_spec, FullAttentionSpec | ChunkedLocalAttentionSpec
        ), (
            "FullAttentionManager can only be used for full attention "
            "and chunked local attention groups"
        )
        block_size = kv_cache_spec.block_size
        if dcp_world_size > 1:
            # DCP shards each block's KV across ranks; hashes must be viewed at
            # the sharded block size.
            block_size *= dcp_world_size
        block_hashes = resolve_block_hashes(
            block_hashes,
            block_pool.hash_block_size,
            block_size,
            supports_fine_grained_hash_lookup=cls.supports_fine_grained_hash_lookup,
            alignment_tokens=alignment_tokens,
        )

        # Fine-grained mode (alignment_tokens == hash_block_size <
        # block_size): resolve_block_hashes kept the raw hash-granularity
        # list so interior boundaries can be probed.
        fine_grained = (
            alignment_tokens < block_size and block_size % alignment_tokens == 0
        )
        if fine_grained:
            # list or lazy BlobBlockHashes view
            assert isinstance(block_hashes, Sequence)
            full_block_hashes: BlockHashList = BlockHashListWithBlockSize(
                block_hashes, alignment_tokens, block_size
            )
        else:
            full_block_hashes = block_hashes

        computed_blocks: tuple[list[KVCacheBlock], ...] = tuple(
            [] for _ in range(len(kv_cache_group_ids))
        )
        # Phase 1: longest run of cached full blocks from the start. A missing
        # block implies every later block misses too (chained hashes).
        for block_hash in itertools.islice(full_block_hashes, max_length // block_size):
            cached_block = block_pool.get_cached_block(block_hash, kv_cache_group_ids)
            if not cached_block:
                break
            for computed, cached in zip(computed_blocks, cached_block):
                computed.append(cached)
        hit_length = len(computed_blocks[0]) * block_size

        # Phase 2 (fine-grained only): extend into the first non-full block by
        # probing its interior hash boundaries high-to-low (longest hit first).
        if fine_grained:
            # list or lazy BlobBlockHashes view
            assert isinstance(block_hashes, Sequence)
            scale_factor = block_size // alignment_tokens
            first_partial_idx = len(computed_blocks[0]) * scale_factor
            max_partial_idx = min(
                first_partial_idx + scale_factor - 1,
                max_length // alignment_tokens,
                len(block_hashes),
            )
            for fine_idx in range(max_partial_idx - 1, first_partial_idx - 1, -1):
                cached_tail = block_pool.get_cached_block(
                    block_hashes[fine_idx], kv_cache_group_ids
                )
                if not cached_tail:
                    continue
                for computed, cached in zip(computed_blocks, cached_tail):
                    computed.append(cached)
                hit_length = (fine_idx + 1) * alignment_tokens
                break

        # Eagle needs the tokens right before the generation point recomputed:
        # drop one hash unit when fine-grained (the tail block's KV is
        # append-only, so it still covers the reduced length), else one cache
        # block.
        if drop_eagle_block and hit_length > 0:
            hit_length -= min(alignment_tokens, block_size)
        # Round down to the alignment; a no-op when fine-grained (hits land on
        # hash boundaries by construction) and when alignment_tokens ==
        # block_size. Then trim blocks past the new tail.
        hit_length -= hit_length % alignment_tokens
        num_blocks = cdiv(hit_length, block_size)
        for computed in computed_blocks:
            del computed[num_blocks:]
        return computed_blocks, hit_length

def cache_blocks(
        self,
        request: Request,
        num_tokens: int,
        retention_interval: int | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        super().cache_blocks(request, num_tokens, retention_interval=retention_interval)
        hash_block_size = self.block_pool.hash_block_size
        if self.block_size == hash_block_size:
            return
        self._cache_partial_tail_block(request, num_tokens)

    def _cache_partial_tail_block(
        self,
        request: Request,
        num_tokens: int,
    ) -> None:
        """Cache the prompt tail when it ends inside a cache block.

        Only the final prompt hash boundary is registered as a partial
        prefix-cache entry; intermediate hash boundaries inside the same cache
        block are intentionally skipped.
        """
        hash_block_size = self.block_pool.hash_block_size
        boundary_tokens = request.num_prompt_tokens // hash_block_size * hash_block_size
        if boundary_tokens == 0 or boundary_tokens > num_tokens:
            return
        if boundary_tokens % self.block_size == 0:
            return

        blocks = self.req_to_blocks[request.request_id]
        block_idx = boundary_tokens // self.block_size
        if block_idx >= len(blocks):
            return
        self.block_pool.cache_partial_block(
            request=request,
            block=blocks[block_idx],
            num_tokens=boundary_tokens,
            kv_cache_group_id=self.kv_cache_group_id,
            block_size=self.block_size,
        )

"""Sparse Mamba state-snapshot retention.

        ``retention_interval``:

          ``None`` -> dense (cache every block; default, unchanged behavior)
          ``0``    -> keep only the ``reachable_boundaries`` states
          ``> 0``  -> keep one state per ``retention_interval``-sized segment

        ``reachable_boundaries`` are proven reuse points (the replay boundary and
        any cross-request shared-prefix junction, Marconi-style APC); their
        boundary state is always kept so sparse retention does not defeat reuse.
        """
        if retention_interval is None or alignment_tokens is None:
            # Dense caching (default) or no alignment constraint imposed.
            return None
        assert isinstance(kv_cache_spec, MambaSpec)
        block_size = kv_cache_spec.block_size
        mask = [False] * (end_block - start_block)

        # (1) Segment-boundary states. A Mamba hit needs exactly the single
        # state block ending on the boundary (no window, and draft models have
        # no mamba layers, so no eagle shift). Block ``i`` ends at token
        # ``(i + 1) * block_size``.
        segment_tokens = None if retention_interval == 0 else retention_interval
        if segment_tokens is not None:
            per_segment = segment_tokens // block_size
            if per_segment <= 1:
                # Interval at/below the block size: every block is a boundary.
                return None
            first_boundary = (
                start_block + per_segment
            ) // per_segment * per_segment - 1
            for i in range(first_boundary - start_block, len(mask), per_segment):
                mask[i] = True

        # (2) Reachable-boundary states: the replay boundary (``num_prompt - 1``,
        # capped by ``get_computed_blocks``) and any shared-prefix junction, both
        # of which segments would otherwise skip under sparse retention. A Mamba
        # hit needs exactly the single state block ending on the boundary.
        for boundary_tokens in reachable_boundaries:
            aligned = boundary_tokens // alignment_tokens * alignment_tokens
            boundary_block = aligned // block_size - 1
            if start_block <= boundary_block < end_block:
                mask[boundary_block - start_block] = True

def get_computed_blocks(self, request: Request) -> tuple[KVCacheBlocks, int, int]:
        """Get the computed (cached) blocks for the request.
        Note that the computed blocks must be full.

        Args:
            request: The request to get the computed blocks.

        Returns:
            A tuple containing:
                - A list of blocks that are computed for the request.
                - The number of computed tokens.
                - ``shared_prefix_boundary``: the block-aligned token position of
                  a shared prefix that a sparse-retention group (Mamba / sliding
                  window) has not cached yet (Marconi-style APC), or 0 if none.
                  Pinned so ``VLLM_PREFIX_CACHE_RETENTION_INTERVAL`` does not drop
                  the junction and defeat cross-request reuse.
        """
        # We skip finding the prefix cache hit when prefix caching is
        # disabled or the request is marked as skipping kv cache read
        # (which happens when the request requires prompt logprobs
        # or calls a pooling model with all pooling).
        if not self.prefix_cache_lookup_enabled(request):
            return self.empty_kv_cache_blocks, 0, 0

        # NOTE: When all tokens hit the cache, we must recompute the last token
        # to obtain logits. Thus, set max_cache_hit_length to prompt_length - 1.
        # This can trigger recomputation of an entire block, rather than just
        # the single last token, because allocate_slots() requires
        # num_computed_tokens to be block-size aligned. Removing this limitation
        # could slightly improve performance in the future.
        max_cache_hit_length = request.num_tokens - 1
        computed_blocks, num_new_computed_tokens, num_uncached = (
            self.coordinator.find_longest_cache_hit(
                request.block_hashes, max_cache_hit_length
            )
        )

        # When kv_cache_report_mode is "full", emit BlockStored events
        # for the reused prefix cache blocks so that external consumers
        # (e.g. gateway) can learn about them.
        if (
            num_new_computed_tokens > 0
            and self.enable_kv_cache_events
            and getattr(request, "kv_cache_report_mode", "incremental") == "full"
        ):
            for group_idx, group_blocks in enumerate(computed_blocks):
                num_blocks = len(group_blocks)
                if num_blocks > 0:
                    group = self.kv_cache_config.kv_cache_groups[group_idx]
                    block_size = group.kv_cache_spec.block_size
                    self.block_pool.emit_cached_block_events(
                        request,
                        num_blocks,
                        block_size,
                        group_idx,
                    )

        # The junction to pin is where the lagging sparse-retention group stops
        # (``num_new_computed_tokens``) plus the uncached shared prefix -- i.e.
        # the longest single-group hit. Sub-block gaps are left to the mask,
        # which floors to the alignment boundary (a no-op there).
        shared_prefix_boundary = (
            num_new_computed_tokens + num_uncached if num_uncached else 0
        )

        blocks = self.create_kv_cache_blocks(computed_blocks)
        return blocks, num_new_computed_tokens, shared_prefix_boundary

def find_longest_cache_hit(
        self,
        block_hashes: list[BlockHash],
        max_cache_hit_length: int,
    ) -> tuple[tuple[list[KVCacheBlock], ...], int, int]:
        """
        Find the longest cache hit using an iterative fixed-point algorithm.

        Each attention type either accepts the current candidate length or
        reduces it. If any type reduces the length, restart checks over all
        types. This converges because length monotonically decreases and is
        bounded below by 0.

        Args:
            block_hashes: The block hashes of the request.
            max_cache_hit_length: The maximum length of the cache hit.

        Returns:
            A tuple containing:
                - A tuple of the cache hit blocks for each single type manager.
                - The number of tokens of the reconciled (combined) cache hit.
                - ``num_uncached_common_prefix_tokens``: a shared prefix that a
                  sparse-retention group has not cached yet (0 unless hybrid).
        """

        num_groups = len(self.kv_cache_config.kv_cache_groups)
        hit_length = max_cache_hit_length
        longest_hit_length = 0
        hit_blocks_by_group: list[list[KVCacheBlock] | None] = [None] * num_groups
        hit_length_by_group: list[int] = [0] * num_groups

        # Simple hybrid (1 full attn + 1 other): one iteration suffices.
        # Full attn is always first if it exists.
        is_simple_hybrid = len(self.attention_groups) == 2 and isinstance(
            self.attention_groups[0].spec, FullAttentionSpec
        )

def _preempt_request(
        self, request: Request, timestamp: float, drop_stale_output: bool = False
    ) -> None:
        """Preempt a request and put it back to the waiting queue.

        NOTE: The request should be popped from the running queue outside of this
        method.

        drop_stale_output: drop (rather than deliver) any in-flight output; used
        by reset_prefix_cache, whose same-step resume would otherwise deliver
        tokens out of order, and for connectors with a pending KV hand-off,
        which the preemption's block free would leave without valid KV.
        """
        assert request.status == RequestStatus.RUNNING, (
            "Only running requests can be preempted"
        )
        self._free_request_blocks(request)
        self.encoder_cache_manager.free(request)
        self._inflight_prefills.discard(request)
        request.status = RequestStatus.PREEMPTED
        request.num_computed_tokens = 0
        if request.spec_token_ids:
            request.spec_token_ids = []
        # Async scheduling: mark all in-flight output as stale. Its tokens are
        # still delivered on return (dropping them would perturb spec-decode
        # acceptance) but must not mutate the reset counters; each step drains
        # its share in update_from_output. num_in_flight_tokens already
        # includes any undrained stale share, so assign rather than accumulate.
        # An undrained drop-mode share stays dropped: its positions have
        # already been resampled.
        request.drop_stale_output = drop_stale_output or (
            request.drop_stale_output and request.num_stale_output_tokens > 0
        )
        request.num_stale_output_tokens = request.num_in_flight_tokens
        request.num_output_placeholders = 0
        request.num_preemptions += 1
        if self.log_stats:
            request.record_event(EngineCoreEventType.PREEMPTED, timestamp)

        # Put the request back to the waiting queue.
        self.waiting.prepend_request(request)
        self.reset_preempted_req_ids.add(request.request_id)

embed_excerpts.code:
prefix_match_unit: int | None = Field(default=None, gt=0)
    """The finest token boundary (in tokens) a prefix-cache hit can land on.

    Prefix-cache keys are computed every `prefix_match_unit` tokens. It can
    be set finer than the physical KV cache block sizes (e.g. 32 vs a
    1024-token hybrid-model block) as long as every KV cache group's
    `block_size` is divisible by it, enabling cache hits at boundaries
    inside a physical block. It controls matching granularity only, not how
    often states are stored.

    This equals to the `hash_block_size` used throughout the KV cache code.
    """

theory: 命中长度推导：prompt 共 P token、块大小 B（单组 hash_block_size=B），有 ⌊P/B⌋ 个满块哈希。find_longest_cache_hit 沿链查到第一个 miss 即停，命中 k 块 ⇒ 复用 k·B 个 token 的 KV、num_new_computed_tokens=k·B，本步只需 prefill P−k·B token。全命中时 max_cache_hit_length=P−1 强制退一 token（要 logits）；又因 num_computed_tokens 须块对齐，实际可能回退整块（kv_cache_manager.py:L253-L258 注释自认此损失）。
链式哈希的『断一处即停』正确性（Merkle 性质）：hash_i 递归依赖 hash_{i-1} ⇒ hash_i 是前 i+1 块全部内容的指纹。两请求前缀一致 ⇔ 沿链哈希逐一相等；反之若 hash_i 未命中（表里没有该键），则对任何 j>i，hash_j 也必不一致（hash_j 含 hash_i 的依赖）——所以 miss 后无需回溯、链上扫描一断即停是正确的，不是启发式。

LRU 双不变量的正确性：不变量一（逆序 free）——同一请求释放的块链中，位置 i 的块可被复用当且仅当来者的前缀 ≥ (i+1)·B；链尾块（i 最大）对应最长前缀要求、潜在复用者最少，应最先驱逐；逆序 append_n 恰好把它排在队头附近。不变量二（劈分）——block_hash is None 的块从未入表、永不可能是命中，让它们插队到队头驱逐不损失任何命中率、只回收死容量。两条都是『顺序即策略』：无断言保护，靠 free 路径的调用约定维持。

F2 量化：被抢占请求已算 C token。抢占 free 后这些满块带哈希回自由队列（LRU 尾）；重排回 waiting 重走 get_computed_blocks 命中 min(⌊C/B⌋·B, 仍在表的块) token——重算成本退化为命中长度之外的部分 + 重挂账本的 O(命中块数) touch。最坏：被抢占期间池紧、块被 get_new_blocks 取走复用（惰性驱逐摘了哈希）→ 全量重 prefill。『重算』的下界=一个 token（全命中），上界=完整 prefill。
CoW 的账：部分命中省下的计算 = 共享块内已缓存部分的重 prefill 算力；付出的 = +1 块显存（cow 目标）+ 一次 GPU 块拷贝带宽 + 三套簿记。当共享前缀以块内边界结束且请求还要继续写时，不 CoW 就得整块重算或写坏别人的缓存——copy 一块（显存带宽级）远便宜于重算一块（矩阵乘级）。

部分命中粒度：hash_block_size=h、block_size=B（B=m·h）。满块链 phase 1 给出 k 个整块命中；phase 2 在第 k+1 块内自高向低探 ≤m−1 个块内边界（block_hashes[k·m .. (k+1)·m−1]），命中即 hit_length=(fine_idx+1)·h。探测顺序自高向低=先试最长。粗块哈希重串零成本：链尾即前缀指纹（BlockHashListWithBlockSize docstring 图例：16 粒度第 2 个哈希直接当 32 粒度哈希用）。
不动点复杂度：候选长度 L 单调不增、取值在 {0, lcm, 2·lcm, ...} 有限集 ⇒ 至多 max_cache_hit_length/lcm_block_size 轮；full 组只查一次（下封闭）；simple hybrid 一轮。实践中常见混合（full+SWA 或 full+Mamba）一轮即收敛，退化为两次单类型扫描。
radix 对比账（教学素材，非源码断言）：链式哈希+平面 dict 的查找=O(命中块数) 次 dict 命中、零节点对象分配（KVCacheBlock slots + 侵入式链表）；radix 树查找=O(深度) 指针跳转+节点分配/合并 GC 压力、块对齐需树上额外维护。v1 选前者的判据=调度循环 CPU 时间是主战场（deepread why_chains[2]）。

mechanisms.name: 链式哈希：hash_i = H(parent_hash, 本块 tokens, extra_keys)——请求侧增量计算、只算新满块；NONE_HASH 随机种子（PYTHONHASHSEED 可共享）；块哈希=整条前缀的指纹

非 radix 的平面哈希表 BlockHashToBlockMap：{hash+group_id(bytes) → block | {block_id: block}}；故意不去重（保块表 append-only，NOTE #1）、union 省 GC（NOTE #2）——radix 迷思澄清（v0=hash+Evictor、SGLang=radix、v1 day one 链式哈希，全仓 v1 core grep radix 零命中）
extra keys 语义隔离：mm_hash/lora_name/cache_salt(仅首块)/prompt_embeds 四源拌进哈希——同 token 不同语义（不同 LoRA/MM 特征/盐）必不同哈希，防跨请求污染命中

满块写回 cache_full_blocks：新满块 set_block_hash+insert 进 map；block_mask 控哪些块入表（永不能服务命中的块不占表）；partial→full 晋升摘旧条目插新条目
LRU 双不变量一·逆序 free：manager.free 把块逆序传入 free_blocks——同请求尾块（更长前缀、潜在复用者更少）先挂回、排更靠驱逐端；次序规则写在 FreeKVCacheBlockQueue 类文档且明言『在类外维持』
LRU 双不变量二·free_blocks 劈分：无哈希块（never match APC）prepend_n 到队头先驱逐、有哈希块 append_n 到 LRU 尾（#42656）；缓存关闭跳过劈分保 GPU 局部性（#48017）——无断言保护、靠调用约定维持
惰性驱逐与别名清理：块被 get_new_blocks 复用时才 _maybe_evict_cached_block 摘哈希（驱逐不发生在 free 时）；_remove_cached_block_hashes 靠 cached_block_hashes_by_block 反向索引把部分条目别名一次摘干净
move_block_hashes：CoW 后把 src 块全部前缀缓存条目重指到 dst 私有拷贝——条目活着不摘，请求块表 append-only 由它兜住
F2 回收·抢占恢复撞前缀缓存：free 不清哈希 → 被抢占请求重排回 waiting 重走准入查询 → get_computed_blocks 重命中自己的前缀 → touch 救回——『重算』变『重载元数据+补算』；最坏（块被惰性驱逐取走复用）退化为全量重 prefill
哈希粒度分离与惰性重串：hash_block_size（=prefix_match_unit 或 GCD，ch14 定）可小于 block_size；BlockHashListWithBlockSize 把细粒度哈希零成本视图成粗块哈希（链尾即前缀指纹）；resolve_block_hashes 细粒度查找时保留原始列表

块内 CoW 部分命中三件套：cache_partial_block 在块内边界注册细粒度条目（不分配新块、块记 _block_hash_num_tokens）+ find phase 2 第一个不满块内自高向低探测 + 命中后共享尾块换私有 cow 块（_partial_hit_reqs → allocate_new_blocks 预留块 → _apply_cow 登记拷贝对）；enable_partial_hash_hits 只限 full+mamba-align 无 CP

CoW 拷贝跨进程管线：take_kv_cache_block_copies drain (source,cow) 对 → SchedulerOutput.kv_cache_block_copies → worker copy_kv_cache_blocks_inplace GPU 执行；两端块引用保留到拷贝跑完（_free_cow_retained_blocks 步序栅栏 + deferred_frees 倒序）
混合不动点最长命中：每注意力类型对候选长度『接受或缩短』、任一缩短重启全类型校验、单调递减有下界必收敛；full 排首且向下封闭（查一次后只 min 裁剪）；simple hybrid 一轮早停；SWA finder 右到左找窗口连续段（[NULL,NULL,8,3]）、Mamba finder 只要边界状态块

Marconi 钉住 shared_prefix_boundary：不动点产出 num_uncached_common_prefix_tokens=longest−reconciled（各组都认但稀疏组还没缓的共享前缀）→ get_computed_blocks 折进 boundary 写回 Request → cache_blocks 的 reachable_boundaries 把 replay 边界与 junction 尾强制置 True（SWA/Mamba mask 特赦段）→ 调度器 _mamba_block_aligned_split 把 chunk 停在 junction 让状态真被算出来
